list.title: Contracts and offers
list.lead: Documents to sign, documents you signed, and offers to renew your lease
list.emptyBody: When your landlord sends you a document to sign or an offer to renew, it appears here

legal.pendingBody: This document is made from a sample in getproperty's contract library. A lawyer has not reviewed this version yet. Read it carefully and ask your landlord if anything is unclear.
legal.reviewedBody: Legal counsel reviewed the template version this document uses. It is still not legal advice for your situation.

detail.signBody: Read the document and sign it here with a code sent to your phone
detail.waitingBody: You have signed. The document is complete when everyone has signed — you will get a LINE message
detail.signedBody: The signed copy is kept as evidence. Open it any time below
detail.pdfBinding: This is a summary. The full document (PDF) is the binding text

sign.unavailableBody: This document cannot be signed right now. Contact your landlord
sign.alreadySigned: You have already signed this document

read.title: Read the document
read.lead: Scroll to the end before you sign. The full document (PDF) is the binding text
read.binding: The PDF holds every clause and is what you sign; its fingerprint is kept with your signature
read.scrollHint: Scroll the document above to the end to continue
read.confirm: I have read the whole document and agree to it
read.updated: The document was updated just now. The current version is shown above — read it again before you sign.

draw.title: Your signature
draw.lead: Sign inside the box with your finger
draw.label: Your signature
draw.upload: Use a photo of my signature
draw.tooLarge: This picture is too large. Draw your signature or choose a smaller photo
draw.uploadHint: Can't draw? Use a photo or scan of your signature instead

otp.title: Confirm with the SMS code
otp.sending: Sending a code to your phone…
otp.wrong: {count, plural, =0 {Wrong code. No tries left — ask for a new code} one {Wrong code. # try left} other {Wrong code. # tries left}}
otp.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s

done.title: Document signed
done.completeBody: The document is complete. The signed copy is kept as evidence
done.waitingBody: The document is complete when everyone has signed. You will get a LINE message
done.hashBody: The SHA-256 of the exact document you signed, kept as evidence

renewal.title: Offer to renew your lease
renewal.subtitle: Unit {unit} · {building} · managed by {operator}
renewal.lead: Your landlord offers to renew your lease on these terms. Answer here before the date shown.
renewal.termsSentence: {amount} a month for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} from {start}
renewal.cardTerms: {amount} / month · {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} from {start}
renewal.leaseBody: {amount} a month for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}. Answer by {date}.
renewal.fromLetter: Answer the offer in the app

accept.title: Renew your lease?
accept.body: {terms}. The new lease comes to you to read and sign right away.

decline.title: Decline the offer
decline.consequence: If you decline, your lease ends on {end}. When 30 days or more are left, your answer is recorded as your notice to move out on that date, and the move-out inspection and deposit refund follow. With fewer days left, the lease simply ends on that date.
decline.consequenceNoDate: If you decline, your lease ends on its end date. When 30 days or more are left, your answer is recorded as your notice to move out on that date, and the move-out inspection and deposit refund follow.

accepted.title: You accepted the offer
accepted.body: Accepted on {date}. Read and sign the new lease to complete the renewal; your deposit carries over.
accepted.bodyNoDate: Read and sign the new lease to complete the renewal; your deposit carries over.
accepted.signCta: Read and sign the new lease

declined.title: You declined the offer
declined.notice: Your notice is recorded: you move out on {date}. Your landlord will contact you about the move-out inspection and your deposit.

expired.title: This offer has expired
expired.body: The date to answer has passed. Contact your landlord if you still want to renew.

withdrawn.title: Your landlord withdrew this offer
withdrawn.body: Nothing changes on your current lease. Contact your landlord with any questions.

home.renewalTitle: Your landlord offers to renew your lease
home.renewalBody: {amount} a month for {months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} — answer by {date}
home.signBody: {count, plural, one {# document to read and sign} other {# documents to read and sign}}
